name: io.github.c0decave/multi-websearch-mcp
title: websearch
description: Captcha-avoiding web, news, image and video search plus page fetching over free sources

environmentVariables.name: WEBSEARCH_UA
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent with your contact (e-mail or URL), e.g. 'websearch/0.3 (you@example.org)'; Wikimedia, GDELT and Hacker News ask for it

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your SearXNG instance (default http://127.0.0.1:8888); without it the feeds and APIs still answer

environmentVariables.name: WEBSEARCH_MCP_PAID
environmentVariables.description: 0 = agents may never use paid APIs
